notes:
Account background:
- Silvercreek builds a modular UX toolkit used by mid-market SaaS product teams (in-app assistants, contextual help, smart search).
- Currently on another LLM vendor (OpenAPI-esque) for chat + search; want to reduce cost and get deterministic latency guarantees.

Engagement summary / POC narrative:
- 2026-02-15: Intro call (Aisha, Marcus). They described 3 main workloads: conversational assistant (low latency), enterprise doc search (embeddings + reranking), nightly batch summarization.
- 2026-02-18 (ff_2026-02-18_001): Technical deep-dive w/infra + ML (Marcus, senior infra eng = Priya Kumar). They asked about compat layer for existing OpenAI-compatible client and function-calling differences.
- 2026-02-22: Sent hosted API quickstart + migration checklist (drive link). POC instructions: 2-week hosted evaluation with parity test suite.
- 2026-03-02 (ff_2026-03-05_002): Hosted POC started. Ran smoke tests: tokenization parity mostly fine, but stop-token handling and function-calling edge cases produced divergent outputs for ~7% of test prompts.
- 2026-03-07: Upload of automated parity results (drive:/POC/...). Marcus: "Some hallucination regressions on long-context reranking - worried about customer impact."

Technical details / requirements called out by customer:
- Latency targets: p95 <= 120ms for short chat (1-2 turns), p95 <= 300ms for reranking on 1-3k tokens.
- Throughput targets: sustained 40-60 qps for chat routes, burst to 150 qps during peak onboarding windows.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-high; want to reduce per-token cost vs current provider by ~20% while maintaining quality.
- Model preferences: open-model family preferred; willing to evaluate Redwood-curated variants and quantized builds. Need fallback routing to lower-cost variants when load spikes.
- Migration specifics: require an OpenAI-compat shim for minimal code changes, prompt-parity tests, and an eval harness to detect regressions automatically.
- Data/security: must support SSO/SAML, audit logs for all requests, KMS integration for keys, and US + EU residency.

POC findings so far (concise):
- Positives: Redwood hosted API easy to swap in (compat SDK mostly works). Observed ~15-25ms lower median latency vs incumbent in same region.
- Issues: Prompt parity failures in function-calling payload format; tokenization differences led to slightly different reranking scores; a small cluster of prompts triggered higher hallucination rate on hosted model variant A.
- Requests from Silvercreek: 1) a guided mitigation plan for parity (tokenization mapping + prompt tweaks), 2) run the parity suite end-to-end on Dedicated with identical model variant, 3) pricing overlay showing Dedicated committed vs hosted usage break-even.

Commercial/Procurement notes:
- Procurement timing: aiming for June decision if POC clears. Budget band $100k-$250k. Decision influenced by committed latency SLO and regression elimination.
- Billing: they prefer committed capacity with predictable monthly spend and overage throttles.

Next actions / owner assignments:
- Marcus (SE): Deliver parity mitigation checklist and patch to SDK that normalizes function-calling payloads (target 2026-03-14).
- Aisha (AE): Schedule Dedicated sizing + pricing call wk of 2026-03-21.
- Legal: Send data residency and DPA draft to Silvercreek legal by 2026-03-16.

Staged migration plan (high level):
1) Hosted POC -> validate parity suite (current).
2) Canary Dedicated deployment with same model variant + KV cache behavior; run 48h regression sweep.
3) Gradual traffic shift with canary rollback policy; A/B checks on output distributions.
4) Full cutover and post-cutover monitoring + quality alerts tied to prompt set.

Quotes / paraphrases captured:
- "We need plug-and-play parity — dev resources are limited, so SDK compatibility matters." — Priya Kumar (senior infra eng)
- "If you can give us predictable p95 and remove the odd regressions, Dedicated makes sense." — Head of Product

Open items / blockers: 
- Final SDK patch to handle function-calling edge cases (SE action).
- Legal signoff on residency clause (in progress).
- Need quantified Dedicated pricing model with burst handling for onboarding spikes.
